Sign-in opened on the computer: allow access in the browser. The MRs will then appear here.
GitHub isn\'t connected on the computer. Connect it to see and merge your PRs from the tablet: the sign-in happens in the computer\'s browser.
The GitHub connection is no longer valid. Reconnect it in the computer\'s browser.
Sign-in opened on the computer: enter the code shown on GitHub and allow access. The PRs will then appear here.

Scroll strip: dragging sideways scrolls the computer

Page opened on the computer: create an Atlassian API token and paste it into the Jira card, with the site and your email. Tickets will then show up here.
Tick the boards whose columns you want (%1$d out of %2$d at most). The first ticked one in the list sets the column order.
No boards found for your projects.
Tick the columns to show. \"All tickets\" shows everyone\'s tickets in that status (50 at most), not just yours.
No board chosen: columns come from boards.
To reply from here: install the hooks on the computer (npm run agents:hooks).
Tap a session to bring it to the front on the computer.
%1$s is in front on the computer
Approve: Claude leaves plan mode, and you\'ll still be asked about each change.

Risky command: hold the button to allow it.
The terminal takes over in %1$d s

Discord found no output: check that it\'s open on the computer

The current output and app volumes (not the mic) will be recalled with one tap. Same name: the scene is replaced.
Set the volumes, then save them as a scene
Drag a scene by its dots to move it.

Tick the apps to show, drag them by their dots to reorder. Nothing ticked: all apps. To group apps on one channel, two of them must be playing. \"Foreground app\" follows the one you\'re looking at on the computer; \"Other apps\" gathers those without a channel.
No app is making sound right now: start one, then come back here.
Computer unreachable: apps that are playing will appear when it responds. You can already untick the chosen ones.
One channel for several apps: its slider and Mute control them all, at the same volume. Tick at least two.
Replace the volumes of \"%1$s\" with the current volumes? The old ones will be lost.

No tabs open in a browser on the computer.
Preview not available for this file type

Let\'s move forward without forcing it.
Make the most of it and go far.
Inhale 5 s, exhale 5 s: calms the heart and stress.
Inhale, hold, exhale, hold, 4 s each: to refocus.
Inhale 4 s, hold 7 s, exhale 8 s: against anxiety, before sleeping.
The list is empty. Say “add milk to the shopping list”.
Without a reminder, the task simply shows in the list.
The tablet says it at that time (tomorrow if the time has passed).

Remove or re-pair a computer: Settings →
Accessibility must be allowed on the Mac: windows and shortcuts are blocked.
Computers with the companion, on the same network.
The address shown by the companion, if the search doesn\'t find it.

The tablet controls the computer in bold. If it stops responding (change of place), it switches by itself to another saved computer that responds. Each computer keeps its own agenda, tasks and Deck. Tap a computer to control it, ✎ to rename it.
No computers. Install the companion on the computer (address: %1$s), on the same WiFi as the tablet, then tap Add.
No computers. Install the companion on the computer: the address is shown on the Welcome screen of the stable tablet app (“Back to stable”), on the same WiFi as the tablet, then tap Add.
Open Mate on the computer to connect: a code shows up here as soon as it\'s waiting for a tablet.
The companion on %1$s is too old for this tablet. Update it: on the computer, open %2$s, download the new app and launch it, then try again.
The companion on %1$s is too old for this tablet. Update it with the stable tablet app (“Back to stable”): the address to download the new app is shown on its Welcome screen. Then try again.
Address shown on the computer, in the companion page opened at installation. Example: 192.168.1.20
No companion at %1$s: check the address, and that it\'s running on the computer.
Enter this code in the Mate page on %1$s.
Insecure connection refused: update the companion on the computer, then try again.
Forget %1$s? To control it again, you\'ll have to pair it again.
Hidden network: type its exact name.
Tap a network to connect to it. Long-press a saved network to forget it.
The tablet can\'t list networks (location is off). Use Other network.
The password is at least 8 characters long.
Couldn\'t connect to %1$s: check the password. The tablet stays on its previous network.
Couldn\'t connect to %1$s (too far?). The tablet stays on its previous network.
Forget the network %1$s? You\'ll have to type its password again.

The web engine and Mate update from GitHub or the computer, without leaving kiosk mode. In kiosk mode, Mate installs published versions by itself (at startup, then every 6 h); a trial only installs with its button.
Can\'t be installed: older than the installed version (%1$s). Android refuses to go back to a lower version.
Updating from the computer isn\'t possible in the trial app: choose the trial in its Settings.
File damaged or modified: different fingerprint, installation cancelled.
Android didn\'t finish the installation: try again later.
Installation refused on the tablet: nothing has changed.
Uninstalling the trial was refused on the tablet: nothing has changed.
Open Mate on the tablet, then try again: Android asks for confirmation there.
Android couldn\'t show its confirmation: installation cancelled.
An update is already in progress: try again in a few minutes.
Can\'t download from GitHub: try again later.
GitHub is limiting requests: try again in a few minutes.
File not found on GitHub: try again in a minute.
GitHub is down: try again in a few minutes.
Camera in use by another app
Camera unavailable: leave Camera mode and come back
Android is installing the update: about %1$d min on this tablet. It can no longer be cancelled.
Older than the trial of PR #%1$d (%2$s): uninstalled first, then installed.
Older than the installed trial (%1$s): uninstalled first, then installed.
This trial is no longer published: its backend can no longer be sent to the computer.
This trial has no backend for this computer (%1$s).
Off: Mate runs like an ordinary app (kiosk: docs/kiosque.md).
Three steps, and the tablet controls your computer.
Connect the tablet to the WiFi at home or the office, the same one as the computer.
In the computer\'s browser, open this address and download Mate:
Mate Trial doesn\'t provide an address. To download Mate on the computer, open the stable tablet app (“Back to stable”): the address is shown on its Welcome screen.
New companion version for %1$s (%2$s): tap to update it

1. On the Mac, reopen “Mate”: the panel opens.
2. “This app” card: “Check for update”, then “Install”. The app replaces itself and restarts.
3. If macOS asks for Accessibility again, grant it (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility).

No panel (old version): open %1$s (“Open on the computer” button), download the new app and open it. Same if “Install” fails (error 404: the panel is too old for this tablet).

Settings and pairing are kept: nothing to redo on the tablet.

1. On the PC, relaunch the companion: the panel opens.
2. “This app” card: “Check for update”, then “Install”. The file replaces itself and restarts.
3. If SmartScreen blocks it: “More info”, then “Run anyway”.

No panel (old installation): open %1$s (“Open on the computer” button), download the new file, run it, then “Remove the old installation” in the panel. Same if “Install” fails (error 404: the panel is too old for this tablet).

Settings and pairing are kept: nothing to redo on the tablet.
The companion on %1$s is moving to version %2$s. It restarts: the computer won\'t respond for a few seconds.
Sending to the computer, then restarting…
A companion update is already in progress.
The companion didn\'t come back in the new version after 2 min: check the computer.

Companion on %1$s launched from the repository: it updates through git.
Companion on %1$s (%2$s): no version published for this computer.

Mac or Windows PC. Once launched, Mate opens its page on the computer.

Choose what the tablet does with %1$s. You can change your mind in Settings.
No compatible app found (Discord, Teams, Claude Code).
Computer apps (Discord, Teams…) and features to show on the tablet.
This computer doesn\'t offer plugins: update the companion.
From the computer shows your computer\'s files and web page.
The viewer shows what the tablet films on your computer\'s screen.
Write what you need to do
Nothing planned. Tap + to add an appointment.
Remind me to drink (9 am – 8 pm, with water on Home)
Drink reminder on, tap to turn it off
Drink reminder off, tap to turn it on
Remember to drink a glass of water.
💧 Remember to drink a glass of water (%1$d / %2$d)
Calendars linked to this computer. Your personal calendar, added here with +, always stays.
No calendar linked. Your personal calendar, added here with +, still shows.
Its appointments will no longer show on the tablet. You can link it again from \"Link another calendar\".
Page opened on the computer: connect your calendar.
Theme, screens, bars and keys can also be set from your computer.
Page opened on the computer: set up the tablet from the card.
Plugged into a computer USB port: charging is slow, a mains charger is safer.
Battery condition: %1$s. Keep the tablet plugged in.
Low battery (%1$d %%): plug in the tablet.
The screen brightens during the day and softens in the evening based on the room\'s light. The slider is greyed out while this is on; at night, the dimming below takes priority.
This tablet has no light sensor: set the brightness with the slider.
The tablet\'s buttons control the active computer\'s output instead of the tablet. Computer unreachable: the buttons do nothing.
Dim the screen at night (10 pm – 7 am)
The screen stays on all the time; at night it drops to minimum, and a tap wakes it up.

The front camera detects movement: with nobody around for 5 minutes, the screen goes black; it turns back on as soon as someone arrives or touches the screen. Everything is processed on the tablet, no image is sent or kept. A camera indicator stays on while this is active.
This tablet has no front camera.
The front camera is watching for movement, nothing is recorded
The front camera is unavailable: presence sleep is paused.
Camera denied: presence sleep stays off.
A tap returns to the screen. To save the screen: reduced brightness, nothing moves between photos, off at night and below 20% battery when unplugged.
Your computer\'s photos scroll by when the tablet is idle.
Photos from the computer\'s \"Photo frame\" folder
No photos: add some to the computer\'s \"Photo frame\" folder.
Open the folder on the computer
A Deck key runs by itself at a set time or at an interval. It runs on your computer, even with the tablet off.
Tap a row to turn it off or delete it.
Nothing is scheduled. Nothing runs until you add something.
No Deck key can be scheduled (hold keys can\'t be).
An old paper grain over the whole screen, in the theme\'s colours
How widgets sit on the wallpaper
Atkinson Hyperlegible, easy-to-tell-apart letters, slightly more spaced out
Turn off the ones that bother you or slow the tablet down. \"Reduce animations\" (Accessibility) turns them all off.
All turned off by \"Reduce animations\" (Accessibility card).
The screen slides, and follows your finger when you swipe up or down
Home widgets arrive one by one; turned off, Home shows faster
They fade in with a slight zoom
The bell rings, the banner slides, the computer dot reacts
Bounces, content fading in, the last seconds of the Pomodoro
Nothing moves continuously any more (Retro tubes, agent indicators), no slides or bounces
PC notifications and computer messages read out by the tablet (in discreet mode: app and title only)
Each key you press is announced aloud: its name, or \"didn\'t work\" (off when TalkBack is active)
Enter your code to unlock it.
Too many attempts: try again in %1$d s
Lock the tablet when the computer is locked
On: screen locked while the computer is. Off: the tablet stays usable; anything that touches the computer replies that it is locked.
The padlock in the bar locks the tablet; this code unlocks it.
If the locked computer is unreachable for 30 s (taken away, lid closed), unlocking it elsewhere does not reopen the tablet: its code is needed.
%1$s is not responding. Enter your code to use the tablet.
On: the app is locked to the screen and acts as the home screen.
Paused until the app next restarts.
To update the app over adb. When off, no app can be installed (the MDM cannot come back).
Off from the factory. Turn it on for a speaker; pairing is then done from Android\'s Bluetooth settings.
Off: the screen flips both ways in landscape depending on how the tablet is held.
Blocks factory reset and safe mode from Android. An offline reset then has to go through the tablet\'s recovery mode.
Lets you power off or restart with the physical button while the kiosk is locked.
Opens adb, to update or troubleshoot the tablet. When off, nobody can read the app or leave the kiosk through the cable.
The tablet will restart. The kiosk will come back on its own. Continue?
Like a brand-new tablet: paired computers, theme, screens, settings and photos are erased. The kiosk and Wi-Fi stay.
Erase everything and start over like a new tablet? You will need to pair the computer again.
The app will no longer be device owner. To turn the kiosk back on, you will have to run the adb command again (and possibly reset the tablet). Continue?
Drag a widget to move it, tap + to add one.
Each screen is a grid of widgets. Tap a name to show it.
An empty grid, ready to fill with widgets.
Tick the apps. When one of them is in front on the computer, the tablet switches to this page, then goes back to the previous screen when you leave it. An app can only lead to one page.
No app found on the computer.

Shape %1$s, %2$d of %3$d. Swipe or use the arrows to change.

Time, next appointment, daily line, agenda, Focus, apps, keys, water and weather.
Time, daily line, agenda, Focus, apps and keys.
Just the time and the daily line: readable from afar.
A ready-to-use setup: profiles and widgets, top banner, navigation bar and theme. It replaces yours, using the computer\'s real data.
Your profiles, their widgets, the top banner, the navigation bar and the theme will be replaced. You can change everything afterwards.
Call in progress: choose the template after the call.
A template is already being applied.
The base setup: the daily Home with agenda, Focus, apps and shortcuts. Warmth theme.
For development: the daily Home, then a screen for Claude agents, GitLab MRs, pipelines and Jira tickets. Night Dial theme.
Apps, computer sound, keys and now playing: act on the computer.
Mic, camera, sharing and call sound: shown during a call.
No computer: time, weather, transport and lights.

Your day at a glance: the next meeting, your tasks, your apps and the essential keys.
One screen to start with. Tap + to add one in a single tap: blank, Office, Standby or Deck (sound and your windows).
One screen to start with. Tap + in the row to add one in a single tap: blank, Office, Standby or Deck (sound and your windows).
Swipe up or down anywhere on the screen to move to the next item in the bar: your screens, then Focus and Computer.
Ask out loud: \"open Outlook\", \"mute the mic\", \"join the meeting\". Long-press to type instead.
The bell, at the top right, shows what happened on the computer; a dot lights up when there\'s something new.

During a call, Meeting appears among the screen keys on its own. Put two fingers on a widget to enlarge it, two fingers again to shrink it back. Hold your finger on the screen to edit it (rearrange, add); long-press a screen key to rename, rearrange, change the icon or delete your screens.
